channel.title: AI Developer Misery Index
channel.description: Near real-time reliability tracking for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot: misery score, status pages and incident alerts. Updated every 15 minutes.

item.title: Misery Index: 0.9/10 — ALL CLEAR (worst: OpenAI 1.9)
item.description: Score: 0.9/10 (ALL CLEAR). Average of four. Worst: OpenAI 1.9. Claude 0.0, OpenAI 1.9, Gemini 1.7, Copilot 0.0.

item.title: [MAJOR] OpenAI: Elevated error rates for gpt-6 Luna API requests
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: major. Latest: All affected services are operating normally again. We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.

item.title: [MINOR] Copilot: Degraded availability for GPT-6 Luna in Copilot
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: minor. Latest: This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

item.title: [MAJOR] Claude: Elevated errors for Claude Mythos 5.2 and Claude Fable 5.2
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: major. Latest: The issue affecting claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork has been resolved. Impact occurred from 00:56 PT / 08:56 UTC to 01:11 PT / 09:11 UTC.

item.title: [MINOR] OpenAI: Costs API data is delayed
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: minor. Latest: All affected services are operating normally again. We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.

item.title: [MINOR] Claude: Claude Meetings auto-join limited on the Team plan
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: minor. Latest: Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls normally. Enterprise and Team customers can add Claude to calls. Auto-join is available for all Enterprise customers and some Team customers. We'll continue rolling out auto-join to additional Team customers in the coming days.

item.title: [MINOR] Claude: Elevated errors affecting the Google Docs connector
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: minor. Latest: The issue affecting editing documents with the Google Docs connector on claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork has been resolved. Impact occurred from 16:19 PT on November 17 / 00:19 UTC on November 18 to 17:33 PT on November 17 / 01:33 UTC on November 18.
